# Plaster and Rendering Solutions Limited

> Plastering and rendering contractor based in Grenoside, Sheffield, covering Sheffield
> (S1–S36), Rotherham (S60–S66) and Barnsley. Founded 2012 by Chris Glover (NVQ-qualified,
> 25+ years). Rated 5.0 from 113 Google reviews. Free survey, no deposit taken, 5-year
> workmanship guarantee, 25-year manufacturer warranty on approved render systems.

Approved applicator for K-Rend, Eco-Rend and Weber. CHAS accredited, CITB registered. Company no. 09075271.
Contact: 07595 399525 / plastersolutionsltd@gmail.com / 3 Rocher Close, Grenoside,
Sheffield S35 8QP.

## Services

- [House rendering](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/rendering-sheffield): all render systems, from £65/m². Hub page with a system comparison table.
- [Silicone render](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/silicone-render-sheffield): flexible, hydrophobic, through-colour thin-coat. K-Rend, Eco-Rend, Weber.
- [Monocouche render](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/monocouche-render-sheffield): single-coat through-colour render, scraped texture finish.
- [External wall insulation](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/ewi-sheffield): EPS or mineral wool plus render. Typical saving £300–600/yr. ECO4 grants.
- [Sand and cement render](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/sand-cement-render-sheffield): traditional two-coat, garden and boundary walls, garages.
- [Render repair](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/render-repair-sheffield): crack repair, blown render, colour-matched patching.
- [Internal plastering](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/plastering-sheffield): skimming, re-plastering, artex removal, ceilings.
- [Dry lining](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/dry-lining-sheffield): dot and dab, insulated board, stud partitions.

## Pricing

- [Rendering costs](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/rendering-cost-sheffield): per-m² and whole-house prices by render system and property type.
- [Plastering costs](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/plastering-cost-sheffield): skim £8–12/m², bonding £10–15, two-coat £12–18, dry lining £18–28. Room-by-room costs.
- [Silicone render vs monocouche](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/silicone-render-vs-monocouche): full comparison, Sheffield climate and conservation areas.
- [Rendering over pebbledash](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/render-over-pebbledash-sheffield): whether pebbledash can be rendered over or has to come off, how to test it, and what each route costs.
- [Pricing and guarantees](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/pricing)

## Guidance

- [Planning permission to render](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/planning-permission-render-sheffield): rendering is usually permitted development, but Sheffield has 35 conservation areas plus Article 4 directions and listed buildings. How to check your address.
- [Rendering through a Sheffield winter](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/rendering-in-winter-sheffield): most renders stop at +5°C. Ecorend SR365 is rated -5°C to +25°C and rainproof in 2 hours above +5°C, so work carries on through the cold months.

## Evidence

- [Millhouses S17 EWI case study](https://www.plasterandrenderingsolutions.co.uk/s17-ewi-case-study): 150mm EPS plus silicone, two weeks, documented at every stage.
